# manta_group (Resource)

Manage groups of components.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "manta_group" "compute" {
  label   = "compute"
  members = local.list_nodes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String)
- `members` (List of String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
